preconditions.description: The number of towns n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n and a[i] != i for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each road a_i must point to a valid town and not to itself.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of valid sets of roads modulo 10^9 + 7.
